messages:
Maria CSM: Quick flag on AcmeRetail 1 -- renewal ~28 days out and onboarding stalled after session 2. Low usage, onboarding owner left mid-handoff. Thinking an 'activation surge' play: triage connector errors, run a 2-week prescriptive enablement, and offer a short credit contingent on hitting Day 7 milestones. Feedback?
Kelly CS: Can you share ARR and last known usage? I can run the enablement if we make it very prescriptive (checklists + calendar invites).
Maria CSM: ARR $48k, current MRR usage near zero. Jonah was the onboarding owner (no longer here) so handoff notes are sparse. I'll paste what we have.
Ajay Eng: Support flagged 502s from their connector on 2026-03-10. Could be payload validation or key rotation. If we can reproduce I'll pair for a hotfix.
Otto Support: Confirmed 502 spikes at 2026-03-10 14:02 UTC. Logs show validation failing when attachments present. Snippet: ```ERROR 502 validation_error: payload.chunk_count mismatch request_id=abc123```
Otto Support: I can open a hotfix branch to skip chunk_count validation for v1 connectors. Low-risk change but want a quick review.
Paul Research: From activation playbook research: two things move renewal risk quickly: (1) a visible first-win within 48h, (2) a repeatable setup path (templates + import). Propose a "first-3-actions" template and a small sample-data import we can run during kickoff.
Kelly CS: I'll run a 2-week schedule: Day 0 kickoff + guided import, Day 3 office hours, Day 7 template + queries review, Day 14 success review + renewal prep. I'll draft customer-facing kickoff msg.
Maria CSM: If Ajay can support the hotfix today, we'll offer a conditioned one-month credit up to $4k if Day 7 milestones are met. Also capturing internal tasks: enablement (Kelly), hotfix & monitoring (Ajay/Otto), credit hold (Finance).
Ajay Eng: I can push the hotfix in the next deploy window (2h). Will keep change small and instrument metrics.
Otto Support: Hotfix branch created. Tagging @Deploy Bot for a canary.
Deploy Bot: Canary scheduled staging 1 -> prod in 40m. Notifying oncall.
Kelly CS: Draft kickoff email (please edit):
```
Subject: Quick kickoff 1 2-week activation plan
Hi Acme team,
We want to make sure you see value quickly. Proposed plan:
- Today: fix connector issue + guided import (30m)
- Day 3: office hours (drop-in)
- Day 7: template + core queries review
- Day 14: success review and renewal prep
If we hit Day 7 milestones we'll apply a 1-month $4k credit. Can you confirm availability for a 30m today?
Thanks, Kelly (CS)
```
Paul Research: Suggest calling out the three immediate wins (export report, basic rerank, embedding search) in the email so benefits are explicit.
Kelly CS: Added that.
Maria CSM: @Finance Ops can we pre-authorize a $4k credit hold conditioned on Day 7 success note? Renewal in 28d and risk of downgrade otherwise.
Finance Ops: Looping in @Claire FP for approval and a note that we need a short postmortem with measured outcomes.
Claire FP: Pre-approve $4k credit hold. Finance will require a 1-page outcome summary after Day 14 to release final accounting.
Otto Support: Canary went well; monitoring shows no regressions after 30m.
Ajay Eng: Prod deploy completed. One automatic retry happened due to a downstream timeout but the hotfix stayed healthy. I've set a 48h alert on validation failures.
Maria CSM: Sending the kickoff now and scheduling the 30m. Kelly 1 please own the Day 7 outcome note for finance. If this format works we should kit it as a reusable 'activation surge' template for other stalled accounts. :muscle:
